description: Trigger and behavior evals for the storycraft-book-to-video skill using the xAI Grok Imagine API.

tests.prompt: Make videos from my sock goblin story
grading_criteria: Resolves the stories repo and book, checks XAI_API_KEY in Phase 0
Does not generate anything before briefs are drafted and approved
Skill triggers on chapter animation request
Scopes the scene inventory to chapter 02 only
Drafts per-scene briefs and stops at the human review gate
Skill triggers on direct name invocation
Resumes from on-disk state under video/ instead of redoing finished work

tests.prompt: Turn my book into short video clips
grading_criteria: Shows the scene inventory and asks which scenes to animate
Confirms clip count and cost before running generate.py

tests.prompt: Write the next chapter of my book
Add illustrations to chapter 2 of my book
grading_criteria: Routes to storycraft's illustration seam explanation, not video generation
